[This is a second-price (Vickrey) auction where the winner pays the second-highest bid. Truthful bidding is a dominant strategy in such auctions: bidding my true value ($30) maximizes expected profit regardless of opponents' strategies. Ties are random, but truthful bidding avoids overpaying while capturing positive surplus when opponents bid below my value. Therefore I will bid my private value of $30.]
